title: New Song Spotlight
description: This week’s spotlight is Coldplay’s “Speed of Sound” — a driving pop-rock anthem with bright piano motion, soaring lift, and a wide-open chorus that gives Djembe a recognizable, energizing moment for the room. It brings modern classic energy into the show rotation with a pulse that feels made for lights, movement, and audience momentum.
songListNote: Coldplay’s driving pop-rock anthem, bringing bright piano motion, soaring lift, and modern classic energy to the show rotation.
